court: Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit

issues.label: Standing of Friends of Animals
issues.why: Court must confirm petitioner has Article III injury, causation, and redressability to seek review.

issues.label: Standard of review under APA
issues.why: Agency action is reviewed under arbitrary-and-capricious/deference standards which frame the entire analysis.

issues.label: Ripeness and finality of permits
issues.why: Court must ensure the Plan and master permits are final agency actions ripe for review.

issues.label: Chevron/Skidmore deference to Service interpretation
issues.why: Court must decide how much deference the Service's statutory interpretations receive.

issues.label: Authority to issue master permits
issues.why: Whether §1539(a) authorizes county master permits and county-issued certificates of inclusion.

issues.label: Delegation of take authority to counties
issues.why: Whether allowing counties to issue certificates of inclusion is a lawful sub-delegation.

issues.label: Minimize/mitigate to maximum extent practicable
issues.why: Court must assess whether the finding under §1539(a)(2)(B)(i) is supported.

issues.label: Adequacy of assured funding finding
issues.why: Whether reliance on Utah and developer fees satisfies §1539(a)(2)(B)(ii).

issues.label: Survival and recovery not appreciably reduced
issues.why: Whether take of up to 7,152 prairie dogs meets §1539(a)(2)(B)(iv) standard.

issues.label: Reasonableness of habitat-loss projections
issues.why: Whether using historical averages was arbitrary given acknowledged possibility of higher development.

issues.label: Adequacy of fivefold-increase contingency analysis
issues.why: Whether the Service adequately accounted for development exceeding historic averages.

issues.label: Reliance on translocation as mitigation
issues.why: Whether translocation reasonably offsets take given uncertainty of establishing new colonies.

issues.label: Effect on recovery units
issues.why: Whether authorizing takes in areas essential to recovery is consistent with the ESA.

issues.label: Jeopardy determination under Section 7
issues.why: Whether the no-jeopardy finding is supported and whether consultation was required.

issues.label: Full-offset conclusion supported by record
issues.why: Whether conclusion that mitigation fully offsets take has record support.

issues.label: Adequacy of monitoring and adaptive management
issues.why: Whether reliance on annual review and monitoring cures uncertainties in the Plan.

issues.label: NEPA compliance and level of review
issues.why: Whether an EA/FONSI sufficed or an EIS was required given potential impacts.

issues.label: Significant environmental impact finding
issues.why: Whether the 'no significant impact' conclusion was arbitrary under NEPA.

issues.label: Consideration of cumulative impacts
issues.why: Whether NEPA required analysis of cumulative development effects across counties and years.

issues.label: Reclassification from endangered to threatened
issues.why: Whether the threatened status and applicable take rules properly govern the analysis.

issues.label: Treatment of low-quality habitat areas
issues.why: Whether differing mitigation for low-quality habitats is justified and lawful.

issues.label: Ten-year permit duration reasonableness
issues.why: Whether projecting impacts and mitigation over a decade was adequately supported.

issues.label: Public participation and notice requirements
issues.why: Whether procedural requirements for adopting the Plan and permits were satisfied.
